Since \(n^3<n(n+1)^2<(n+1)^3\), the cube root lies between \(n\) and \(n+1\).  
Now compare it with \(n+\frac35\) and \(n+\frac{7}{10}\).

For \(n\ge 2\),
\[
n^3+2n^2+n-\left(n+\frac35\right)^3
=\frac15n^2-\frac{2}{25}n-\frac{27}{125}>0,
\]
and
\[
\left(n+\frac{7}{10}\right)^3-(n^3+2n^2+n)
=\frac1{10}n^2+\frac{47}{100}n+\frac{343}{1000}>0.
\]
Thus
\[
n+\frac35 < \sqrt[3]{n^3+2n^2+n} < n+\frac{7}{10}.
\]
So the fractional part is between \(0.6\) and \(0.7\), meaning the first digit after the decimal point is \(6\).

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
